rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice when something is adequate, acceptable, or passable rather than especially good.

example.english: The report is satisfactory enough to hand in.
example.traditional: 份報告做得過得去，交到功課喇。
example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 zou6 dak1 gwo3 dak1 heoi3 gaau1 dou3 gung1 fo3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the thing causes satisfaction or is pleasing, especially in descriptions such as results or performance.

example.english: The service this time is really satisfactory.
example.traditional: 今次嘅服務真係令人滿意。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ge3 fuk6 mou6 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 mun5 ji3
